import dataclasses, json, pathlib
from unittest.mock import patch
from rawlsing_next.tests import test_pre553_ee14_selected_lifecycle_source_free_integration as T
from rawlsing_next import pre553_analytical_composition as C1
from rawlsing_next import pre553_service_source_applicability as SA
from rawlsing_next import pre553_service_f8_source_scope_binding as G2
out = pathlib.Path('/tmp/rawlsing_hq280_b2r_evidence_r1')
case = T.case.__wrapped__()
trace, rows, captured = [], {}, {}
functions = [(C1,'compose_positioned_subject_possibility','C1'), (SA,'resolve_service_source_applicability','SA'), (G2,'bind_service_applicability_to_f8_scope','G2'), (G2,'evaluate_bound_positioned_subject_possibility','F8')]
def observer(fn, name):
    def called(*args, **kwargs):
        trace.append(name)
        result = fn(*args, **kwargs)
        captured.setdefault(name, []).append(result)
        return result
    return called
from contextlib import ExitStack
with ExitStack() as stack:
    for module, attr, name in functions:
        stack.enter_context(patch.object(module, attr, observer(getattr(module,attr),name)))
    for cell, expected in [('q1',({'0':1,'1':1},2)),('q2',({'0':0,'1':1},1))]:
        trace.clear(); captured.clear()
        origin = case['ingress'].serve(T.G1.SelectedRequest(cell=cell,stratum_ids=T.G1.Q1_STRATUM if cell=='q1' else T.G1.Q2_STRATUM))
        composition = case['cells'][cell]['composition']
        numerators = {r['cell']:r['raw_numerator_support'] for r in composition.consumer_result_or_null.material()['exact_lane']['geometry']['cells']}
        assert (numerators,composition.raw_denominator_support) == expected
        assert trace[0]=='C1' and all(name in trace for name in ['C1','SA','G2','F8'])
        assert trace.index('SA') < trace.index('G2') < trace.index('F8')
        assert origin.g2_receipt_hash == captured['SA'][0].replay_identity()
        assert origin.f8_result_hash == captured['F8'][0].result_hash == composition.consumer_result_or_null.result_hash
        assert origin.authorizing is False
        rows[cell] = dict(trace=list(trace),numerators=numerators,denominator=composition.raw_denominator_support, origin_receipt=dataclasses.asdict(origin), producer_query_ref=composition.producer_query_ref.as_dict(), source_release=case['source']['release_ref'].as_dict(), selected_m2_release=case['cells'][cell]['m2_release'].ref.as_dict(), g2_replay_hash_parity=True, bound_f8_direct_c1_parity=True)
first = T._join(case,as_of_event_ref=case['first'].current_select_event_ref,mode='CURRENT')
second = T._advance(case)
current = T._join(case,as_of_event_ref=second.current_select_event_ref,mode='CURRENT')
historical = T._join(case,as_of_event_ref=case['first'].current_select_event_ref,mode='HISTORICAL')
assert historical['selection_receipt']==first['selection_receipt']
assert current['selected_m2_release']!=historical['selected_m2_release']
contract = T.I4.LearnedWorldProductContractBinding(route='M1_M2_B5', product_family_ref=T.FAMILY,producer_owner_ref=T.OWNER,producer_contract_ref=T.PRODUCER_CONTRACT,release_subject_kind='TYPED_DISPOSITION',selection_scope_ref=T.SCOPE,producer_permission_ceiling_ref=T.PERMISSION_CEILING,consumer_product_purpose_ref=T.PURPOSE)
try:
    T.I4.adapt_m2_release_to_b5(case['cells']['q1']['artifacts'],contract=contract)
except T.I4.LearnedWorldCompositionBlocked as exc:
    contract_ref_refusal=str(exc)
    assert 'current M1 disposition owner' in contract_ref_refusal
else:
    raise AssertionError('I4 allowed incorrect producer contract')
result=dict(kind='BOUNDED_SOURCEFREE_INDEPENDENT_OBSERVATION_NOT_ADOPTION', cells=rows, current_q1=first,current_q2=current,historical_q1=historical, generic_fixture_producer_contract=T.PRODUCER_CONTRACT.as_dict(),fixture_nonissuer_authority=T.SNAPSHOT.as_dict(), i4_wrong_producer_even_with_typed_disposition=contract_ref_refusal, no_model_use_grant=True)
(out/'supplemental_observations.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({cell:{k:v for k,v in row.items() if k in ['trace','numerators','denominator','g2_replay_hash_parity','bound_f8_direct_c1_parity']} for cell,row in rows.items()},indent=2))
print(contract_ref_refusal)
